name: Dart
description: The ConEx Dart is the most massive ship ever built. The design for it is a couple centuries old. But when ConEx put it out on the market, people were crazy to buy it. Its turning is a little above the bulk freighter, and the acceleration is terrible, but the Dart has one unique feature, it has a top speed the same as the Confederate Patrol Ship.
escort: Whoo Momma, This whip is huge. Do you really need all the cargo?
